game.title: Call of Duty: Vanguard
game.blurb: Military first-person shooter from Raven Software, Treyarch, Beenox, Sledgehammer Games and High Moon Studios (as RAWG lists them), released 2021-11-05. RAWG average playtime: 9 hours. Genres: Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Campaign
chapters.summary: Starting and finishing the campaign on any difficulty, plus three hidden milestones. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Campaign Mission Challenges
chapters.summary: Mission-specific feats in Phoenix, Operation Tonga, Stalingrad, The Battle of Midway, Numa Numa Trail, Lady Nightingale, The Rats of Tobruk, El Alamein and The Fourth Reich.

chapters.title: Squad Abilities and Campaign Skills
chapters.summary: Each squad member's ability (Arthur, Polina, Wade, Lucas), blind fire, scavenging ammo, trying many weapons and smashing through walls.

chapters.title: Multiplayer
chapters.summary: Levelling up your rank, an operator and a weapon in Multiplayer.

chapters.title: Zombies
chapters.summary: Covenants, Hearts, Demonic Fountains, Artifacts and zombie kill counts, including Der Anfang.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has no page under "Call of Duty: Vanguard" or "Call of Duty Vanguard". callofduty.fandom.com answers the API under "Call of Duty: Vanguard" with 500 linked articles (the query limit, so possibly more); names only were looked at, nothing copied. 3 of 44 Steam achievements are hidden ("F", "Not Your Fairy Godmother" and "Couldn't Have Done it Without You") and sit in the campaign chapter as a placeholder. Steam API names start SP_ (campaign), MP_ (multiplayer) and ZM_ (zombies); "Hello There" (Start the Campaign) has an MP_ name but was put with the campaign. The mission chapter lists missions by the names the achievement descriptions use, in Steam list order, which may not be play order. Many campaign skill achievements show 0.8% on Steam.
